scripts.title: 99nitf auto join game extremely useless open source
scripts.script:
if game.PlaceId ~= 79546208627805 then return end

local p = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local ws = workspace
local gui = p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("Interface"):WaitForChild("LobbyCreate")
local b1 = gui.ButtonList:WaitForChild("Button1")
local cb = gui.HeaderFrame:WaitForChild("CreateButton")

for _,v in ipairs(ws:GetDescendants()) do
    if v:IsA("TextLabel") and string.find(v.Name, "Players") and string.find(v.Text, "0/5") then
        local parent = v.Parent
        while parent and not parent:FindFirstChild("EnterPart") do
            parent = parent.Parent
        end
        if parent and parent:FindFirstChild("EnterPart") then
            local ep = parent:FindFirstChild("EnterPart")
            local hrp = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                hrp.CFrame = ep.CFrame
            end
            break
        end
    end
end

local debounce = false

while true do
    if gui.Visible then
        if not debounce and b1.BackgroundColor3 ~= Color3.fromRGB(255,225,0) then
            debounce = true
            repeat
                b1:Activate()
                task.wait(0.1)
            until b1.BackgroundColor3 == Color3.fromRGB(255,225,0)
            debounce = false
        end

        if b1.BackgroundColor3 == Color3.fromRGB(255,225,0) then
            cb:Activate()
        end
    end
    task.wait(0.5)
end
